panel.tasks: frozen200 FROZEN200_POLICY.json tasks (200), identical to cube_clean

fault_model.draw_rule: bit-identical reuse of frozen200_run.build_faults(seed, 0.3, tasks, pools): random.Random(seed); sample 60 uids in policy order; choice node in {e1,e2,r,v}; pool draw from adaptive_benchmark/FAULT_POOLS.json
fault_model.kind: persistent capability fault keyed (task_uid, node, planned_model(config)): every execution attempt of that triple returns the drawn failing answer with the clean execution's measured usage/latency (FZ-1 reference-cost semantics); retrying the same model persists; a different model escapes

node_mapping.e1: PARALLELER/DYNAMICDAG: fault branch e1; SER/SERV: fault the single e node
node_mapping.e2: PARALLELER/DYNAMICDAG: fault branch e2; SER/SERV: fault the single e node
node_mapping.v: SERV/DYNAMICDAG only; on SER/PARALLELER the v-fault is LATENT (recorded, inactive)

fault_model.latent_note: per-topology effective fault exposure differs (SER/PARALLELER cannot express v faults); frozen rule, same draw stream keeps all configs paired on the same (task,node) fault set
fault_model.cost_accounting: injected triple: usage/latency = that config's clean planned execution from cube_clean ledger; mark injected_fault=true; NEVER enters the prompt cache

configs.ids: SER/SERV/PARALLELER x {BALANCED,HETEROGENEOUS,QUALITY} x NONE + DYNAMICDAG x {BALANCED,HETEROGENEOUS,QUALITY} x {NONE, LOCAL_REROUTE} = 15
configs.dedup_lift: under s_fault30 the clean dedup LIFTS: DYNAMICDAG NONE and LOCAL_REROUTE are distinct evaluations (15 total, not 12)

propagation_rules.mandatory_real_propagation: any node whose INPUT changes (upstream fault/recovery altered facts or expression) MUST be re-executed: prompt-cache (model, sha(prompt)) hit, else REAL model call; NEVER fall back to a same-key clean record under a changed prompt (the f30_static defect, see FROZEN200_FAULT_PROVENANCE.json); infrastructure failure aborts the run
propagation_rules.seed_isolation: each (seed, config) evaluation derives state only from (a) immutable pure-execution prompt-cache snapshots, (b) the explicit fault registry, (c) records written within the same (seed, config); no by_key carry-over across seeds or configs (the 0/2/8 leakage flips in the legacy run)
detection_ungated: e-failure: parsed facts empty (cannot distinguish injected fault from natural extraction failure; recovery fires on both)
v-failure: json_value None OR (r parseable and value disagrees with r-value)

recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.scope: DYNAMICDAG only; one attempt per detected failure; ungated; descendant closure
recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.e_rule_memory: first detected e-failure within the (seed, config) evaluation reroutes to coder; subsequent to medium (per-config memory, matches frozen200 per-arm memory scope)
recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.closure: e-recovery -> recompute r (planned model) -> recompute v (planned); r-recovery -> recompute v (planned)
recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.ineffective_reroute: reroute target == faulted planned model (BALANCED/QUALITY r-faults escalate large->large; QUALITY v-faults large->large; BALANCED e-faults on 2nd+ memory draw medium->medium): the persistent fault serves the attempt (no real call, clean-ref cost, no state change)
recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.natural_failures: detection also fires on naturally failed nodes; their recoveries are REAL calls and genuine config cost (this is the dynamic topology's semantics); the analyzer separates fault-attributable deltas (faulted tasks only, paired) from natural-recovery deltas
recovery_Z_LOCAL_REROUTE.clean_dedup_caveat: the clean cube's DYNAMICDAG LOCAL_REROUTE value is the planned-chain idealization (shared with NONE); under fault30 LOCAL_REROUTE recovers natural failures too, so clean->fault delta for this label conflates both effects; use the faulted-task-only paired delta for the fault effect

objectives.Q: topology's own final producer, identical to cube_clean scoring (SER/PARALLELER: value_of on latest r; SERV/DYNAMICDAG: json_value on latest v); averaged over 200 tasks x 3 seeds (n=600), mean and per-seed
objectives.C: sum of node total_tokens: injected triples at clean-reference cost + real executions at measured cost
objectives.L: critical path as in cube_clean (max over parallel e1/e2) with recovery appended at the failure point; NOTE: frozen200's dynamic arm used serial-sum latency, so the f30_dynamic L anchor is approximate by construction

cache.prompt_version_hashes: recorded at protocol freeze in fault30_protocol.PROMPT_VERSION_SHA
cache.boundary: prompt cache admits ONLY delivered, non-injected records paired with their requests (audited_cache.load_prompt_cache semantics); fault injections / failure status / reroute decisions NEVER cached or shared across clean/fault states
cache.execution_key_format: f30:{TOPO}:{FAM}:{node}[:{kind}]:{uid} with kind in {fb, fbd, esc} for recovery calls

anchors.internal_primary: unfaulted tasks under NONE must reproduce clean cube per-task results exactly (bit-level check in fault30_analyze); this is the primary anchor and needs no legacy data
anchors.single_anchor: SINGLE__QUALITY__RETRY__FRESH fault values carried from frozen200 f30_single (bookkeeping fault by design: Q .3967, C 802.0, L 0.59); zero new calls
anchors.weak_anchor: DYNAMICDAG__HETEROGENEOUS__LOCAL_REROUTE Q within tolerance of f30_dynamic .4033 (real recoveries exist in the legacy ledger; memory-rule scope and L accounting differ, tolerance = max(0.02, 2x legacy seed std) = 0.02)
anchors.excluded: f30_static (.2933): tainted provenance (e/r injections recorded as no-ops; see FROZEN200_FAULT_PROVENANCE.json); DYNAMICDAG__HETEROGENEOUS__NONE under this protocol is its first genuine measurement

execution_gating.dry_run_first: fault30_protocol.py plans every (seed, config, task) call with zero model calls; forecast reviewed before any execution
execution_gating.gpu_exclusive: fault30_run.py acquires collect/logs/local_gpu.lock (exclusive) and refuses to start while cube_clean or any vLLM server holds the GPU or port 8128
execution_gating.order: after cube_clean completes and its server exits
